The '''Alliance Valorous Services Medal''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] medal awarded to individuals who conducted perilous operations for the Rebellion with success and displayed exceptional bravery in the face of danger.<ref name="SWG:AVSM" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one such medal was awarded to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] alongside several Rebel supporters who had rescued a highly-decorated [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Alliance pilot]] from captivity during the assault of a [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]].<ref name="SWG:CC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=heroic|Corellian Corvette}}</ref>

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had a similar award named [[Imperial Valorous Services Medal]].<ref name="SWG:IVSM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=collection|Imperial Valorous Services Medal}}</ref>
